title: Integral derived operations commute with finite scalar extension
statement:
Let $E\subset L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ (inside a fixed
algebraic closure), with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$, let
$f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible, and for
$W\in\{X,Y\}$ let
$K\mapsto K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L
=R\varprojlim_m\operatorname{Res}_m(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L/\varpi_L^m)$
be the integral scalar-extension functor [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] underlying the rational one (levelwise
modulo powers of the uniformizers), defined on derived complete objects of
$D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ and carrying $D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$ into
$D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_L)$. For the integral derived operations
$Lf^*$, $\widehat\otimes^L$ and $R\mathcal Hom$ over $\mathcal O_E$ and over
$\mathcal O_L$ there are isomorphisms, natural in all variables,

$$
 (Lf_E^*K)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L\cong Lf_L^*(K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L),
 \qquad
 (M\widehat\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}N)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L\cong
 (M\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)\widehat\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_L}(N\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L),
$$
$$
 R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_E}(M,N)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L\cong
 R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_L}(M\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L,N\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)
$$

for $K\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ and $M,N\in D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$ (the
internal Hom being derived complete because $N$ is), and for
$E\subset L\subset L'$ they are compatible with the composition isomorphisms
$(K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)\otimes_{\mathcal O_L}\mathcal O_{L'}\cong K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_{L'}$
and equal to the identity for $L=E$.

proof.text: Write $R_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$, $S_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{L,W}$ and $T_W=-\otimes^L_{R_W}S_W$. By [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], $S_W$ is finite free and the specified integral scalar functor equals $T_W$ on complete inputs, through its natural quotient-augmentation map $\chi$.

source.place: Final paragraph: 'define the operation by the compatible finite reductions, the derived inverse limit for O_E ... and the common-stage coefficient construction for Qbar_l'.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr], the valuation rings are principal ideal domains, hence Noetherian. The reduction theorem [lem-weil-pbc-completed-constant-sheaf-reduction] identifies $R_W/t^nR_W$ with $(\mathcal O_E/t^n)_W$ and makes $t$ regular. Koszul reconstruction and the completion reflector identify quotient completion $C_R$ with local derived completion: a complete $K$ is isomorphic to $C_RK$, hence satisfies the reflector's local vanishing criterion, so its specified unit is invertible. The same applies over $L$.

source.place: Final paragraph: 'define the operation by the compatible finite reductions, the derived inverse limit for O_E ... and the common-stage coefficient construction for Qbar_l'.

proof.text: The DVR factorization [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr] gives $t=uv^e$, $u$ a unit and $e\geq1$ since $|t|<1$. Products are exact on these pro-etale module categories. Thus [lem-pur-finite-free-completion-exchange] gives $T_WC_R\cong C_ST_W$ on arbitrary ambient inputs, respecting the quotient units.

source.place: Final paragraph: 'define the operation by the compatible finite reductions, the derived inverse limit for O_E ... and the common-stage coefficient construction for Qbar_l'.

proof.text: Put $F_R,F_S$ for ordinary ambient pullbacks. The ambient-model lemma identifies $Lf_E^*=C_RF_R$ and $Lf_L^*=C_SF_S$. Ringed pullback composition gives $T_XF_R\cong F_ST_Y$: both paths are $S_X\otimes^L_{f^{-1}R_Y}f^{-1}(-)$. Exchange completion to obtain $T_XC_RF_R\cong C_ST_XF_R\cong C_SF_ST_Y$, proving the pullback assertion through $\chi$.

source.place: Final paragraph: 'define the operation by the compatible finite reductions, the derived inverse limit for O_E ... and the common-stage coefficient construction for Qbar_l'.

proof.text: The same model lemma writes completed tensor as $C_R(M\otimes^L_{R_W}N)$. The canonical tensor comparison for change of rings and completion exchange give $T_WC_R(M\otimes^LN)\cong C_S(T_WM\otimes^L_{S_W}T_WN)$, the second assertion. The completion outputs are complete by Step 2, so $\chi$ applies.

source.place: Final paragraph: 'define the operation by the compatible finite reductions, the derived inverse limit for O_E ... and the common-stage coefficient construction for Qbar_l'.

proof.text: If $N$ is complete, the local-completeness theorem for internal Hom and Step 2 make $H_R(M,N)$ complete. Finite-free Hom base change is the evaluation-defined natural isomorphism $T_WH_R(M,N)\cong H_S(T_WM,T_WN)$. Apply $\chi$ to its complete inputs to obtain the third assertion, without imposing perfectness on $M$.
